metrics.name: follow_up_questions
metrics.title: Follow-up questions
metrics.evidence: Many of the questions point at specific parts of the generated code, such as "'+asyncpg'?", "'CMD-SHELL'?", "What is value_wo", "Why these locals?", "Why are we using by alias?" and "Show me that kepair change as a diff", and none of these could be asked without reading the output.

metrics.name: coding_guidelines
metrics.title: Coding guidelines
metrics.evidence: The coding, git, IaC, Python and project CLAUDE.md rules were in context and the diff broadly complies with them (commit subjects such as `feat(api): add prefect proxy handler` follow the scoped Angular form), but the branch adds `api/cloudfront_functions/basic_auth.js`, which the JavaScript rule file covers, and that file never reached context.

metrics.name: output_amendments
metrics.title: Output amendments
metrics.evidence: 858 of 1202 generated lines were rewritten after the author challenged them

metrics.name: prompt_granularity
metrics.title: Prompt granularity
metrics.evidence: The median is 26 generated lines across the 73 prompts that produced output, which is under the band-3 threshold of 50, and most prompts ask for a single change (e.g. 'Split to a types file, and a dedicated file for the Prefect class'); the few large outputs, such as 535 lines from 'Keep Cloudfront' and 558 from a 'y', approve plan steps that had already been laid out, so they do not outweigh the median.

metrics.title: Generative comments
